name: seo-content-audit
summary: Audit existing content for SEO query and SERP fit, freshness, decay signals, overlap, and refresh or consolidation recommendations.
inputs: keyword and SERP-intent artifacts when available
declared first-party, provider, crawl, CMS, and user sources
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: approved GA4 or Google Search Console data
approved current external page or SERP evidence
approval_gates: provider_availability: run a bounded read-only availability check against approved integration surfaces; do not reveal secrets or probe arbitrary services
external_read: ask before current external content, SERP, ranking-page, or provider reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require applicable approval
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: deletion, redirect, CMS, repository, analytics, publishing, production, and provider configuration changes are out of scope
done_when: scope, content inventory, domain, market, language, device, date range, and audit date are explicit
provider status is recorded for each declared source
local content and relevant client context were inspected before conclusions
keyword and SERP evidence is source-labeled and date-scoped
decay is measured or marked as a hypothesis; age alone is not treated as evidence
semantic similarity is not called cannibalization without supporting evidence
each asset has a recommended action and rationale
refresh and new-content handoffs are explicit and preserve Writing ownership
durable artifact uses project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated metrics
verify live external reads had approval
verify age, traffic, or ranking movement was not presented as proof of decay without comparable evidence
verify semantic similarity was not presented as proof of cannibalization
verify no delete, redirect, CMS, code, analytics, publishing, or production action occurred
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
